Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VI OF 2000
INDUSTRIAL
STATISTICS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE VI OF 2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Industrial Statistics Act, 1942
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th February, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
26-2-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Industrial Statistics
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 8 Act XIX of 1942

ORDINANCE VI OF 2000
INDUSTRIAL
STATISTICS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE VI OF 2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Industrial Statistics Act, 1942
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 26th February, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
26-2-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 8, Act
XIX of 1942.--In the Industrial Statistics Act, 1942 (XIX of 1942),
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 8,--
(i) for the words "five
thousand" the words "twenty thousand" shall ,e substituted; and
(ii) for the words "two
hundred" the words "eight hundred" shall be substituted.

Amendment of section 9 Act XIX of 1942

3. Amendment of section 9, Act
XIX of 1942.--In the said Act, in section 9, for the words "one
thousand" the words "four thousand" shall be substituted.
